design: 6 goals x 4 frozen strategies x 3 paired single-turn framings
interpretation: This small pilot found no unsafe increase under the original prompts, but it does not isolate a framing-only effect. Candidate messages lacked direct elicitation, the context arm supplied safety guidance, and the case-analysis count is confounded by the auxiliary audit configuration. Surrogate-guided selection and cumulative optimization remain to be tested with the corrected design.
